target.transfer_policy: fit a shared PN-family distribution; never label DL5 response values as DM1 measurements

observables.loss: per-cell Huber loss over the complete registered current ramp
observables.held_out_rule: report RMSE, Huber loss, rheobase error and gain error for each held-out cell

observables.loss: per-cell baseline-corrected waveform Huber loss over 0-200 ms
observables.held_out_rule: report waveform RMSE plus peak-amplitude, peak-time and decay-time errors

parameter_prior_policy.dm1_passive_parameters: sample the three published Gouwens-Wilson fits as a population prior
parameter_prior_policy.active_parameters: fit only to registered fit cells
parameter_prior_policy.synaptic_parameters: fit only to registered fit-cell uEPSC traces
parameter_prior_policy.held_out_access: held-out cells are loaded only after parameter freeze

acceptance.numerical: finite trajectories without undocumented clipping or resets
acceptance.cellular: held-out error reported relative to fit-cohort-to-held-out biological error
acceptance.synaptic: held-out amplitude and timing reported separately; sign and kinetics cannot be inferred from topology alone
acceptance.tier_policy: readiness and fitting award no tier; V1/V2 require an immutable held-out evidence bundle

claim_boundary: Cross-specimen uniglomerular-PN parameter fitting using female DM1 priors and female DL5 recordings; not MaleCNS-donor physiology and not brain-wide validation.
